subject: Jordan Price — signing package & acceptance window
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Jordan Price — offer deadline and signing package

Laura — quick heads-up. Jordan (candidate for Sr. SWE, onsite infra team) surfaced a competing package and needs an answer by EOD Friday (2027-08-20). Key points: 
- Current offer: base $195k, 15% target bonus, 0.20% equity (4y)
- Counter from their recruiter: ~$210k base equivalent + $20k signing cash + faster equity cliff
- Candidate would prefer Redwood but asks for a larger sign-on or earlier equity cliff to bridge comp gap

Suggested options for productizing the counteroffer quickly: 
1) Approve a one-time signing bonus ($12k–$18k) and extend acceptance window to 72 hours after we send the revised PDF
2) Fast-track a headcount exception for an earlier start bonus (one-time) to be charged to Q3 hiring flexibility

I attached Jordan’s resume and the req note. If you want me to open with a softened number ($12k + 2-week relocation stip), I can — but we’ll need budget OK from finance and an explicit sign-off from Jonas for the headcount carve.

Attachments: candidate_resume_jordan_price.pdf, req-314_headcount_note.pdf

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0126

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:03:18Z
Subject: Re: Jordan Price — offer deadline and signing package

Thanks for the summary, Ava. A few quick asks before we escalate: 
- Can you confirm the candidate’s start-date flexibility? If they can push two weeks, we might close without the max signing.
- What does the SR Eng band allow for one-time cash? See comp band doc (I think we can go up to $15k without exec sign-off).

If Jordan is firmly at a hard deadline, my preference is to approve up to $15k sign-on (one-time cash) and extend the acceptance window to 72 hours. We should avoid altering equity schedule unless the candidate has a genuine retention concern.

If Jonas is comfortable with a small headcount carve for Q3, that will help speed things. Looping Jonas for headcount / budget sign-off.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T12:40:05Z
Subject: Jordan Price — request: headcount carve + sign-on approval (REQ-314)

Jonas / Marissa — Jordan has a hard competing offer and needs confirmation by Friday. Laura recommends up to $15k sign-on and 72-hour extension. 

Quick context: 
- Role: Sr. SWE, Infra (req-314) — open role budgeted for Q3 but hiring plan front-load means we’d need a short-term carve to guarantee start date in mid-September.
- Candidate is open to a Sep 20 start but cannot wait beyond the competing offer timeline.
- Impact: high — Jordan has relevant infra experience and would be a direct contributor to the K/V cache performance work.

Requested approvals: 
- Headcount carve: allow req-314 to proceed from the reserved pool (one slot) so we can lock the start date.
- Signing bonus: up to $15,000 one-time cash (non-recurring) charged to the hiring flexibility budget.

I attached the req note for budget coding. If you can confirm with a quick reply I’ll incorporate into the updated offer PDF and send to Jordan + recruiter.

Attachments: req-314_headcount_note.pdf

Thanks,
Ava
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T14:05:42Z
Subject: Re: Jordan Price — request: headcount carve + sign-on approval (REQ-314)

Ava / Laura — I’m fine to make a one-off exception here given the signal and scarcity. Approve: 
- Headcount carve for req-314 (one slot) for Q3 hiring flexibility.
- Signing bonus up to $12,000 immediately; if there’s a strong case for $15,000, Marissa please confirm budget availability. 

Marissa — please confirm we have the budget to support up to $15k; otherwise authorize $12k and I’ll sign off. This should be charged to hiring flexibility and coded to the infra cost center.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP of Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, ava.chen@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:20:10Z
Subject: Re: Jordan Price — request: headcount carve + sign-on approval (REQ-314)

Thanks — quick finance check completed. We have room in the hiring flexibility pool to cover a one-time signing bonus up to $15,000 for req-314, provided: 
- It is recorded as a one-time cash payment on the contractor/offboarding ledger; 
- Offer PDF clearly marks the signing bonus as non-recurring; 
- The comp band note is attached for audit.

I attached the SR Eng comp band doc for reference. Proceed with $15k if you believe this moves the needle; otherwise $12k is acceptable. Let me know which amount you instruct us to book.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance — People Ops Budgeting
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>, MasonTech Recruiting <recruiting@masontech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-15T10:05:00Z
Subject: Updated offer — Jordan Price (Sr. SWE, Infra)

Jordan / MasonTech team — thanks for your patience. We’re able to revise the offer as follows (final): 
- Base: $195,000 (unchanged)
- Target bonus: 15%
- Equity: 0.20% (standard schedule)
- One-time signing bonus: $15,000 (non-recurring cash, paid after 30 days)
- Start date: flexible; preferred Sep 20 but we can work with earlier dates if needed
- Acceptance window: 72 hours from receipt of the updated offer PDF

I attached the updated_offer_20270815.pdf. Please review and let us know within the acceptance window. If you’re ready to accept, sign and send back the attached PDF and we’ll start onboarding prep.

Attachments: updated_offer_20270815.pdf

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@gmail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MasonTech Recruiting <recruiting@masontech.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T17:22:11Z
Subject: Re: Updated offer — Jordan Price (Sr. SWE, Infra)

Ava — thank you and appreciate the quick turn. I’m inclined to accept — the $15k signing bonus and flexibility on start date seals it. One minor ask: can we move the equity cliff from 12 months to 9 months (still 4y vesting) to align with an anticipated liquidity event window at my current employer? I can sign and return if we keep the cliff as-is, but thought I’d check if that spacing tweak is possible.

If not, I’ll sign the updated PDF within the 72-hour window. Either way, I’m excited to join Redwood and appreciate the team moving fast.

—Jordan
